reason: The analyst controls for mgmt_rating_2023, a post-treatment variable (mediator or collider) measured after training, and this flips the estimate to -2.14. My own analysis, which excludes it and adjusts for the pre-period covariates, gives a modest positive effect of about +0.58 (p=0.013). The analyst also omitted several pre-period confounders, trimmed the sample, and ran only one specification, so the 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported.
